## Differentially abundant genes in response to irrigation

# Load packages
```{r}
library(DESeq2)
library(GUniFrac)
```

# Perform gene differential abundance analysis

```{r}
metadata1 <- read.csv("./Data/Metadata.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
metadata <- subset(metadata1, Irrigation != 'NA')
otutab1 <- read.csv("./Data/RPKM.KO.abundance_9353.csv", header = T, row.names = 1) # DESeq2 need taxa(rows) by samples(columns)
head(otutab1)

otutab2 <- otutab1[,rownames(metadata)]
otutab <- otutab2[rowSums(otutab2)>0, ]

identical(rownames(metadata), colnames(otutab))

countData <- as(otutab, "matrix")  # convert the countData object to a matrix
head(countData)
str(countData)

library(dplyr)
countData.new <- round(countData, digits = 0)

#construct the data object from matrix of counts and the metadata table
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = countData.new,
                              colData = metadata,
                              design = ~ Irrigation)

# filter the data
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds))>0,]
dds
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds) # Normalize the Count Data
sizeFactors(dds)
# Estimate the Dispersion
dds <- estimateDispersions(dds)

# local - use the locfit package to fit a local regression of log dispersions over log base mean 
# (normal scale means and dispersions are input and output for dispersionFunction). 
# mean - use the mean of gene-wise dispersion estimates
dds <- DESeq(dds, fitType = 'local', parallel = FALSE)
res <- results(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Irrigation", "irrigated","non-irrigated"))

resOrdered <- res[order(res$padj), ]
summary(res)
summary(res$padj < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)

# Differentially abundant genes with adjusted P-values < 0.1
diff_gene <- subset(res, padj < 0.1 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 0)
table(res$padj < 0.1 & res$log2FoldChange > 0)

res1 <- res[which(res$padj<0.01 & res$log2FoldChange)>1,]
sum(res$padj<0.01 & abs(res$log2FoldChange)>1, na.rm = TRUE)
write.csv(as.data.frame(diff_gene), file= "./Output/irrigated vs non-irragated_differentially.abundant.csv")
write.csv(as.data.frame(res), file= "./Output/irrigated vs non-irragated_Comparison.csv")

```


# 2. Map differentially abundant genes to KEGG annotations

```{r}
library(dplyr)

differ.gene <- read.csv("./Output/irrigated vs non-irragated_differentially.abundant.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
kegg <- read.csv("./Data/kegg.pathway.table.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)

# extract rownames of differ.gene data
differ.row <- rownames(differ.gene)

# Match KO name in differ.gene data and KEGG table
matched_idx <- match(differ.row, kegg$KO)

# Match KO name in KEGG table
kegg_matched <- data.frame(diff_gene, kegg[matched_idx, ])
print(kegg_matched)

write.csv(kegg_matched, file = "./Output/irrigated vs non-irragated_differentially.abundant.csv")
```
